name: admins
help: Show a list of online administrators

name: animations
help: Open the animations / emotes menu

name: bounties
help: Check the list of players with a bounty on their head

name: bounty
help: Place a money bounty on a player's head

name: cancelmission
help: Cancel your active side mission.

name: event
help: Displays active events and bonuses

name: events
help: Show active and upcoming server events.

name: fare
help: Set your taxi fare per kilometre (there is a maximum).

name: help
help: Open the wiki. /help <page> jumps straight to a page, e.g. /help police.

name: id
help: Displays your server ID

name: info
help: Open your personal statistics

name: invite
help: Let a nearby player into the property you own (garage or house).

name: jobs
help: Open job list menu.

name: kill
help: Commit suicide

name: local
help: Local message for players in 20m radius

name: lock
help: Lock the nearest vehicle, or lock it for a specific ID

name: newplayers
help: Show players currently under New Player Protection

name: paramedic
help: Show which paramedics are on duty.

name: ping
help: Displays your connection latency

name: pm
help: Send a private message to a player

name: properties
help: Open your properties list

name: quitjob
help: Quit your current job or leave your gang.

name: r
help: Quick reply to the last private message

name: refreshrewards
help: Claim any pending rewards.

name: report
help: Report an issue or player: /report [Optional ID] [Reason]

name: stats
help: Open your personal statistics

name: taxi
help: Request a taxi to your location

name: timestamp
help: Show/hide timestamp in chat.

name: top
help: Open the server leaderboards

name: uninvite
help: Take back the property invites you gave a player.

help: Unlock the nearest vehicle, or unlock it for a specific ID

name: vehicles
help: Open your vehicles list

help: Show gamemode and resource component versions
